book.title: MAK Kamambuno wakai Mak muno boglkwa

content: Yesus sigoramnedi pre ka dikeglkwa
Pasova enge kande bret yis paikrukwa keunde bir ninaglkwa ana enge suwo yoko pango ana pris kande wagle ya lo beke teingwa yomba Yesus kanesi sigoramnedi kimbi koglo ere teke yeingwa.
Ba ye dingwa, “Nono enge kade mina yegl erekramga, yegl oun kade yomba deno kumbro kunda boraglkwa.”
Ambu ta kungo demine orkwa toindi Yesus bre mina endungwa

Betani kamun Saimon kaglande sungwa yagle kei pamara Yesus pi yungugl mogl kaiya mokna ne moglko ana ambu ta yungugl ungwa. Ye mingi giglendi ta kungo demine orkwa kausi moglko yungwa, i topo kande boglkwa, ana ambumo i mingi siblendi ana kungo toindi Yesus bre mina endungwa.
Yomba tau igle meglkwa deno kumbruko ye yene di imboriya ende dingwa, “Sragl mem pango kungo demine orkwa i yoko yu akesume?
I topo bogl yumuna daglma 300 kina pai ende mina oma indre ana moni ipi gonduglme yomba tomgo.” A na ambumo i ye kenaglmo singwa.
Ba Yesus dungwa, “Kanwinge eriyo, ene sraglpre ambu i mir inambedi pre dime? Ambu i sragl wakai kaima pamara na ere narkwa.
Kiuglgiunde yomba engenge ene bogl akiye moraglkwa. Ana enge tau ene akeple dinagledi pitn kade ene akepledi to. Ba na ene bogl engenge ta moglkramga.
Ambu i taragl erambuka pamara orkwa. Ambu kungo demine orkwa toindi nangina mina endungwa i na maugl mina panaglka pre komuno kana akekun orkwa.
Na ka kaima ene diteinga, makan uglomugl koglkoglo prapra kamambuno wakai dipene ende diwaidi enaglmara, ambu taragl orkwa i akiye ditembi, ye orkwa i pir moraglkwa.”
Yesus sigoraglmedi pre Judas pra i-pene ende tenagle dungwa
Ana Yesus disaipelmo 12 mina suwarata Judas Iskariot, ye ende pris kande wagle meglmara pindre Yesus i-pene ende kunda ikine tenagledi pre ongwa.
Ye gunyei sragl ka dinambuka i pirtre ana ye moni tenamnedi pre ka dipandigl dingwa. Yeglpre Judas mambuno bogl enge wakai ta yenan, Yesus i tekoglo endinagledi pre kuie kanmoglkwa.
Yesus disaipelma bogl Pasova kaiya mokna neingwa

Bret yis paikruko neingwa enge yongo ana komnaiye ye mambunono pangwa i, sipsip nangigle kombuglange gagl Pasova enge ama kaiya mokna ninaglkwa pre disaipel wagle krapogl Yesus teingwa, “No pi aglokra Pasova enge kaiya mokna akekun ere yomun ana ene ninagledi pitne?”
Yeglpre Yesus disaipelmo suwo dimenda ende ditongwa, “Ene siti suna piro. Ana yagl ta nigl mingi kake indre wu ene tengigl yenambuka, ana ye enambara i piro.
Ye ta yungugl enambara i ene pindre yungu nemyagl diteiro, ‘Beke norkwa yagle krapoglkwa: Na yungu kula aglo kra? Na disaipelna wagle bogl Pasova kaiya mokna ninamne.’
Ye yungugl kugl kar tembe mundu ene ombuno ditenambuka, kaiya mokna tembe yei ninaglkwa bogl ya, amedi moraglkwa endi egle akiye akekun ere kondingwa. Nono kaiya ninamga pre igle ene akekun eriro.”
Ana disaipel suwo ende siti suna pindre ana taragl prapra Yesus ditomere mere kan indre ana Pasova ninaglkwa pre akekun eurika.
Ana kamun mim kor pango, Yesus disaipelma 12 bogl wingwa.
Igle ye endi egle mina amedi kaiya mokna ne meglko Yesus dungwa, “Na ka kaima ene diteinga, ene mina suwarata na i-pene ende kunda ikine tenambuka, ye na bogl kaiya mokna akiye ne moglkwa.”
Disaipel wagle ye kinde kaima pirtre ana mambuno bogl suwara suwarandi krapogl teingwa, “Ene na pre kaima mendigl pandigl dino?”
Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Ene 12 meglmara suna i suwarata, ye na bogl akiye bret i dis mina suna endumbuglka.
Yomba Wam gorambedi kamambuno pepa mina muno beglko pangwa pre ye kaima gorambuka. Ba Yomba Wam yaglkumba tongwa yomba i yumbun kande inambuka, mam okuna kugl yeikruma daglma i wakai kaima orko.”
Yesus eremogl bret ya wain disaipelmo wagle tongwa
Ye kaiya mokna ne meglko, Yesus bret indre kamange ere God diwakai yei ana bukondi yene disaipelma wagle tendre, yegl dungwa, “Ene iyo, i na nangina yongwa.”
Ana ye kap wain ta indre, God diwakai yei ana disaipelma wagle tongo, ye nigl mingi i mina prapra neingwa.
Yesus ditongwa, “I na bormaina kontrak kor yomba merkinde pre toindi yangungwa.
Na kaima ene diteinga, na wain nigl i aglketa nekre moglpi ana enge ta yenan wain kor God kingdomo mina suna i aglke ninaglka.”
Ana ye giglange suwarata dindre, ende menda pi Olip Kamun Muglo eingwa.
Pita okuwo Yesus kangina ditorwa erambe dungwa
Yesus disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Ene prapra teke pindre ana na kondinaglkwa. Sraglpre, kamambuno mina muno yegl beglkwa pangwa:

content.text: sigoglmbo, ana sipsip prapra undupagl eraglkwa.’

content: Ba okuwo na andigl ukor pindre ana Galili kamun na ende okuna yei tenaglka.”
Pita di ikine endungwa, “Ana prapra yange sindre ene kinde kondimbi na ene ta kinde kondokraglka.”
Yesus di ikine ende tongwa, “Na ka kaima ene diteinga, enduwer konduwagle wi enge suwo sikran, ene enge suwota na Yesus kankrika we dinatnga.”
Ana Pita ka giglendi kaima di ikine endungwa, “Na ene kankrika we kaima ta dikraglka, na ene bogl akiye gorambuglka.” Ana disaipel wagle prapra kuno yegl keunde dingwa.
Yesus Gesemani suna kamange orkwa
Ye endpi dumo ta kangiye Gesemani we dimara eingo ana Yesus disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Na kamange era eiwa. Ene igle amedi molo.”
Ana Pita ya Jems ya te Jon auro indre ana ye mambuno bogl dem munduwo kinde kaima orko ana yumbun kande wu ye mina bre kake orkwa.
Ana ye ditongwa, “Na kuiyana kinde kaima orko ana goraglka pai dungwa. Ene magl igle mogltre ana sugl aimande kan molo.”
Ana kurita ende eglke dagl pindre, yene yange makandle sindre ana giu i ye mina undinambedi pre kamange orkwa.
Ye kamange ere dungwa, “Aba, na Nina.
Taragl prapra ene eratnga keunde pangwa. Geu mingi i na mina i-yeglke endo. Ba taragl na pirka mere i kondo ene pitnere ero.”
Okuwo ye ende ikine undre ana kango disaipel suwota ye uglpai meglkwa. Ana ye eremogl Pita ditongwa, “Saimon, ene uglpai meglmo? Ene ande kuiya suwarata sugl moglkraglmo?
Kamange ere sugl molo, baglnu mina yangesi dinaglmiwo. Spiritno pra eragledi prukwa, ba nangino yumbun dongwa.”
Ye aglke ende eglke pindre ana kamange ere, ka dumere yeglkra kuno dungwa.
Ye aglke ende ikine disaipel suwota meglmara undre ana kango ye ugl paingwa. Sraglpre, ye ongumutno yumbun dongo, ye sragl wedi Yesus tenaglkwa i ta pirkrikwa.

Aglke ende pindre ana ikine ungo enge suwota orko, ye disaipel suwota ikra ditongwa, “Ene ugl aimande paimogl ana mogl ir si pirmo? I kuno orkwa! Ande kuiya magl orkwa. Kaniyo, Yomba Wam erme tekoglo ende tandaglme yomba onguno mina yenaglkwa.
Ana andiglmbi ende omuno. Kaniyo, na ipi kunda ikine onguno mina yenambuka yagle magl ungwa!”
Yesus sikane singwa

Yesus ka di moglko, ye disaipelmo 12, mina suwarata Judas ungwa, te yomba merkinde ye bogl dikumba prak ya kumba pond ake indre wingwa. Pris kande ya te lo beke teingwa yomba ya te ende okuna eingwa yomba diendingo wingwa.
Ana yaglkumba tongwa yaglmo ye diu ta erambere ditongwa, “Na ta kungro-bare eraglka yaglmo suwara i ye sikane sindre ana okuna okuwo ere akegidi yend piyo.”
Judas oglandi ende Yesus moglmara pindre ana dungwa, “Beke Notnga!” dindre kungro-bare orkwa.
Ana yomba Yesus ake gidindre sikane singwa.
Ba yomba meglmara suwarata andigl moglkwa, ye dikumba prakmo gundo indre sungo pris kande nigl kongunmo yomba ta kina simbiglkidi endungwa.
Ana Yesus ditongwa, “Ene dikumba prak ya kumba pond indre na kunogl gogl yomba ta moglmedi na sikane sina pre wimo?
Ande enge yomere yomere na ene bogl akiye mogl God holi yungu toglmo sunakra ka beke teingra, ana ene ta na kane sikrikwa. Ba Kamambuno okuna muno beglkwa pangwa ikra kaima pai inambuka.”
Ana disaipelmo wagle prapra ye kindekondo undupagl ere teke ende perepere eingwa.
Yagl gakmugl suwarata yokoko teke ongwa
Yagl gakmugl suwarata gagl olto suwara ta ende pandigl, Yesus omara ongo ye sikane singwa.
Ba ye gaglmo olto gugl kindekondo yokoko teke endongwa.
Yesus ipi kaunsol kande meglmara eingwa
Ana Yesus ipi pris kande mina ende okuna ongwa kei pamara eingo ana pris kande wagle prapra ya yomba mina ende okuna eingwa ya te lo beke teingwa yomba wu makai singwa.

Pita kurita eglke dagl Yesus omara mokomugl pindre ana endpi pris kande ende okuna ongwa yungumo togl suna ongwa. Igle ye kimbirnem sugl meglkwa bogl akiye amedi meglko ana ye ende gaglmara pir moglkwa.
Pris kande wagle ya kaunsol prapra Yesus ka ta di aglau eran i-pene ende sigora pre dokingwa, ba ye aglaumo ta doko kan ikrikwa.
Yomba merkinde kakimbi di Yesus nangiye dangingwa. Ba ye ka boglo kiglkwa i wu suwara pikrukwa.
Ana yomba tau andigltre ana kakimbi yegl di Yesus nangiye dangingwa,
“No punga ye yegl dungwa, ‘God holi yungumo yomba keingwa i na sigurndi atne ende, ana ande enge suwota mina aglke kei ikine endinaglka. I yomba onguno mina keikraglkwa.’”
Ba ye ka boglo singwa i wu perepere ongo ana kuno erekrukwa.
Pris kande mogl okuna endungwa, ye prapra meglmara gumanomugl andigl mogl ana ye krapogl Yesus tongwa, “Ka di ene nangin dangingwa i ta di ikine endinatnga paikrumo?”
Ba Yesus kiendi mogl ana ka suwarata di ikine endekrukwa. Ana aglke pris kande kor krapogl tongwa, “Ene Krais God ere wakai ere tongwa ikra Wam motno?”
Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Na moglka iwe. Ana ene prapra kanimbi Yomba Wam, God Yaglkande ongo wokra amedi mogl ana heven kamun kua kruwo bogl akiye unambuka.”
Ana pris kande yene gaglmo suna olto ake argla dindre ana dungwa, “Nono kawaiye eraglkwa aglketa pirkramga.
Ye God kenaglmo sungo pirkwa, ene sragl eramnedi pirme?” Ye drano prapra kakimbi di ye nangiye sidange ana ye pra sigolo dingwa.
Tau mambuno bogl eursi Yesus tendre ana ongumuglo tusi, onguno ake bukondi ere sindre ana dingwa, “Kankre dipoglo, ira ene sum?” Ana kimbirnem Yesus indre atndang singwa.
Pita eremogl Yesus kankrika we dungwa
Pita togl suna yoglmbo kra mogl pango, pris kande nigl kongunmo ambai suwarata moglmara ungwa.
Enge igle ye kango Pita endi domara pir moglko ana ambai toro giglendi kandre dungwa, “Ene ama Yesus, Nasaret nem bogl akiye wanmiurkra.”
Ba Pita ditorwa ere dungwa, “Na ye ta kankrika, ene ka dinga i na ta pirpogl sikrika.” Ana Pita togl dra mina ende menda ongo, ana tambre konduwagle kumugl wi sungwa.
Ana nigl-kongun ambai i Pita eglire moglko kandre ana aglke yomba magl andigl meglkwa i ditongwa, “Ye ama akiye wanmeglkura.”
Ba Pita aglkekor ditorwa orkwa. Kurita meglko okuwo yomba magl andigl meglkwa i kordagl di Pita teingwa, “Kaima yene, ene ye bogl akiye waningura. Sraglpre, ene ama Galili nem kra.”
Ana Pita ka giglendi ditongwa, “Na ka kaima yene diga! Na kakimbi dimbo God na erekinde ere narambuka. Ene yaglmo dingwa i na ta kankrika.”

Yegl dungo ana oglandi konduwagle kumugl wi aglke sungo suwo orko, ana Pita eremogl Yesus ka okuna ditongwa ikra prukwa, “Konduwagle wi enge suwo sikran ene enge suwota na ye kankrika we dinatnga.” Ana ye yangesi oglmbugldi indre ana kai pond orkwa.

footnotes.text: Yesus kamo “Aba” i nono kanno “Nina” we dumga.
